caption:
Some people think hot showers are bad for you when it's cold outside. But taking a hot shower when it's cold can be linked to helping your body relax. 
   What do you think happens to your body when you take a hot shower in cold weather? 
   🚿💦
comments_seeded: I've noticed I often feel more relaxed after a hot shower on a cold day. Is this just my body or is something else at play?
Some folks say it's all about the contrast between the hot water and cold air. Is this what makes the difference?
How often do you take hot showers during the cold months and do you notice any difference in how you feel?
It's also worth thinking about how hot showers might affect your skin and sinuses when it's cold outside. Anyone have any thoughts on this?
What's your favorite way to warm up on a cold day - hot shower, warm bath, or something else entirely?
